title: Hilbert's Curve: Is infinite math useful?
summary: 3Blue1Brown explains space-filling curves and the Hilbert curve, and how infinite mathematical constructions connect to finite, practical approximations. It touches on mapping between dimensions and sensory ideas.
why: Recommended as the best visual introduction to Hilbert curves, which come up in indexing, image layout and dimensionality mapping.

quote.text: This is a great video on the Hilbert curve
